name: @jsrepo/mcp

tools.name: add_item_to_project
tools.description: Add a registry item or items to the users project.

cwd.description: The path of the current working directory. Used to find the jsrepo.config file.

items.description: The registry and name of the item to add `<registry>/<item-name>`. i.e. "github/ieedan/std/math", "@ieedan/std/math", "https://example.com/registry/math"

itemNames.description: Fully qualifed registry items to add. i.e. ["github/ieedan/std/math", "@ieedan/std/math", "https://example.com/registry/math"]

with.description: Include files with these roles. Built-in optional roles: example, doc, test. Custom roles are also supported.

tools.name: view_registry_item
tools.description: View the code and information about a registry item.

cwd.description: The path of the current working directory. Used to find the jsrepo.config file.

item.description: The registry and name of the item to add `<registry>/<item-name>`. i.e. "github/ieedan/std/math", "@ieedan/std/math", "https://example.com/registry/math"

tools.name: list_items_in_registry
tools.description: List items in a registry. You can optionally provide a query to filter the results.

cwd.description: The path of the current working directory. Used to find the jsrepo.config file.

registries.description: The registries to search for items in. i.e. ["github/ieedan/std", "@ieedan/std"]

query.description: The query to search for. i.e. "math"

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 10.

offset.description: The numbers to skip for pagination.
